{{Top|leg}}
'''Fangball''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] that was home to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]]. Fangballs traveled in swarms, tumbling up from behind their targets.<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>
